testcase.name: Scenario: Dismiss the panel list without changing visibility: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/panel-visibility-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:155:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss the panel list without changing visibility ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is expanded and docked at the top ✔ And Modify is visible while Parameters is hidden ✔ When the user opens the ribbon context menu and expand Show Panels ✔ Then Modify is checked and Parameters is unchecked ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the Show Panels submenu closes ✔ And the ribbon context menu remains open ✔ When the user presses Escape again ✔ Then the ribbon context menu closes ✔ And Modify remains visible ✔ And Parameters remains hidden
